senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. preced.) platforms or elevations erected for public spectacles.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1058">Yalk. Esth. 1058</cite> all the people shall go out <he>להדין א׳</he> (read <he>להנהו א׳</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>להון פרטי</he>, corr. acc.) to the spectacular elevations, for a Jew (Mordecai) is to be hanged. V. <cite ref="A01971"><he>אמבוניא</he></cite>.
